associations.rationale: This is the construction of the two-dimensional family Vrep; its bare function type does not itself assert the classification.
The type directly proves that every nondegenerate member Vrep N j in the classified two-dimensional family is irreducible.
The type directly distinguishes members of the two-dimensional family when their character invariants differ, supplying the non-isomorphism part of the classification.
The displayed equivalence directly classifies all one-dimensional characters by the stated parameter constraints.
This only restricts an arbitrary irreducible representation to dimension one or two; it is a structural prerequisite for, rather than the classification itself.
The sum-of-squared-dimensions identity is a counting/completeness tool and does not identify an arbitrary irreducible representation.
This cardinality of one-dimensional characters in the even case is a numerical consequence supporting the classification, not an identification of the representations.
This cardinality of one-dimensional characters in the odd case is a numerical consequence supporting the classification, not an identification of the representations.

The type quantifies over every simple finite-dimensional representation and says it is isomorphic either to a character representation or to a nondegenerate Vrep, directly giving exhaustiveness of the classification.
This computes the total number of listed irreducibles in the even case; it is a consequence/check of the classification rather than its representation-level statement.
This computes the total number of listed irreducibles in the odd case; it is a consequence/check of the classification rather than its representation-level statement.
This only counts the even-case two-dimensional index set, a numerical consequence supporting the classified list.
This only counts the odd-case two-dimensional index set, a numerical consequence supporting the classified list.
